    # Read more around the grade
    text = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, offset-200), 4000)

    print(text[:3000])
    
print("\n\n=== Checking for grader tail ===")
gt = await CONTEXT.search("[grader tail]")
if gt['items']:
    for item in gt['items']:
        offset = item['offset']
        text = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 3000)
        print(text[:3000])
